en: Send *menu* at any time to see the main menu.
sn: Tumira *menu* chero nguva kuti uone menyu huru.
nd: Thumela *menu* nini lanini ukuze ubone imenyu enkulu.

en: Sorry, I didn't understand that. Please use the buttons, or send *menu*.
sn: Ndine urombo, handina kunzwisisa. Shandisa mabhatani, kana tumira *menu*.
nd: Uxolo, angizwisisanga. Sebenzisa amabhatani, kumbe uthumele *menu*.

en: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
sn: Pane chakanganisika kwatiri. Edza zvakare munguva pfupi.
nd: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle kithi. Zama futhi masinyane.

en: What year were you born? For example: 1999
Please send the year as four numbers, for example 1999.
Which month were you born? Send a number from 1 to 12.
sn: Makazvarwa mwedzi upi? Tumira nhamba kubva pa1 kusvika pa12.
nd: Wazalwa ngenyanga bani? Thumela inombolo kusukela ku-1 kusiya ku-12.

en: Please send a number from 1 to 12.
sn: Tumira nhamba kubva pa1 kusvika pa12.
nd: Thumela inombolo kusukela ku-1 kusiya ku-12.

en: Skills Passport is for artisans aged 18 to 35. Thank you for your interest.
sn: Skills Passport ndeyemhizha dzine makore 18 kusvika 35. Tinotenda nekufarira kwenyu.
nd: I-Skills Passport ngeyezingcitshi ezileminyaka eyi-18 kusiya kweyi-35. Siyabonga ngokuthakazelela kwenu.

en: Do you live and work in Zimbabwe?
Skills Passport is only available in Zimbabwe for now. Thank you for your interest.
sn: Skills Passport iri muZimbabwe chete parizvino. Tinotenda nekufarira kwenyu.
nd: I-Skills Passport itholakala eZimbabwe kuphela okwamanje. Siyabonga ngokuthakazelela kwenu.

en:
Before we start, here is how we use your information:

• We keep your name, phone number, trade and area.
• Your public passport shows your first name, trade, suburb, confirmed jobs, ratings and the work photos you choose.
• We never show your phone number, exact location or what you charged.
• We send each client one WhatsApp message asking them to confirm the job.
• You can delete your account at any time.

Do you agree?
sn:
Tisati tatanga, hezvi zvatinoita neruzivo rwenyu:

• Tinochengeta zita renyu, nhamba yefoni, basa renyu nenzvimbo.
• Passport yenyu inoratidza zita rekutanga, basa, sabhabhu, mabasa akasimbiswa, mamaki nemifananidzo yamunosarudza.
• Hatimbofi takaratidza nhamba yefoni, nzvimbo chaiyo kana mari yamakabhadharisa.
• Tinotumira mutengi wega wega meseji imwe yeWhatsApp kuti asimbise basa.
• Munogona kudzima account yenyu chero nguva.

Munobvuma here?
nd:
Singakaqali, nansi indlela esisebenzisa ngayo ulwazi lwakho:

• Sigcina ibizo lakho, inombolo yefoni, umsebenzi wakho lendawo.
• I-passport yakho ikhombisa ibizo lakho lokuqala, umsebenzi, isabhabhu, imisebenzi eqinisekisiweyo, amamaki lemifanekiso oyikhethayo.
• Kasisoze sikhombise inombolo yefoni, indawo eqondileyo kumbe imali oyibhadalisileyo.
• Sithumela umthengi ngamunye umlayezo owodwa we-WhatsApp ukuthi aqinisekise umsebenzi.
• Ungacima i-akhawunti yakho nini lanini.

Uyavuma yini?

en: No problem. We have not saved anything. Send *hi* if you change your mind.
sn: Hapana dambudziko. Hatina kuchengeta chinhu. Tumira *hi* kana mukachinja pfungwa.
nd: Akulandaba. Kasigcinanga lutho. Thumela *hi* nxa ungaguqula umqondo.

en: What is your first name and surname?
Please send your first name and surname, for example: Tendai Moyo.
sn: Tumira zita nemusoro, semuenzaniso: Tendai Moyo.
nd: Thumela ibizo lesibongo, isibonelo: Tendai Moyo.

en: Added *{trade}*. Do you also work in a second trade?
sn: Tawedzera *{trade}*. Munoshandawo here mune rimwe basa?

en: Which city do you work in?
Which area do you mostly work in?
Thanks. A field agent will add your area. For now we'll use {area}.
sn: Tatenda. Mumiriri achawedzera nzvimbo yenyu. Parizvino tichashandisa {area}.
nd: Siyabonga. Umsebenzi wasendaweni uzakwengeza indawo yakho. Okwamanje sizasebenzisa {area}.

en: How many years have you worked in this trade?
sn: Mava nemakore mangani muchiita basa iri?

en: How did you learn your trade?
Optional: may we ask about gender and disability? We use this only in anonymous reports about who Skills Passport reaches, unless you choose to show a badge.
sn: Hazvimanikidzwi: tingabvunza here nezve kuti muri munhurume kana munhukadzi uye kuremara? Tinozvishandisa mumishumo isina mazita chete, kunze kwekunge masarudza kuratidza bheji.
nd: Akusibopho: singabuza yini ngobulili lokukhubazeka? Sikusebenzisa emibikweni engelamabizo kuphela, ngaphandle kokuthi ukhethe ukukhombisa ibheji.

en: Do you live with a disability?
Would you like a *Women in Trades* badge on your public passport?
sn: Mungada here bheji re*Women in Trades* papassport yenyu?
nd: Ungathanda yini ibheji ye-*Women in Trades* ku-passport yakho?

en: Last step: send a profile photo, or tap Skip. A clear photo of you at work builds trust.
sn: Danho rekupedzisira: tumira mufananidzo wenyu, kana dzvanya Darika. Mufananidzo wakajeka muri kubasa unovaka kuvimbika.
nd: Isinyathelo sokucina: thumela umfanekiso wakho, kumbe ucindezele Yeqa. Umfanekiso ocacileyo usemsebenzini wakha ukuthenjwa.

en:
Your Skills Passport is ready.

Passport number: *{code}*
Level: Starter
Your page: {link}

Next: log your first job. After each job, send photos and a short voice note, and your client confirms with one tap.
sn:
Skills Passport yenyu yagadzirira.

Nhamba yepassport: *{code}*
Chikamu: Starter
Peji renyu: {link}

Zvinotevera: nyorai basa renyu rekutanga. Mushure mebasa rega rega, tumirai mifananidzo nevoice note pfupi, mutengi wenyu osimbisa nekudzvanya kamwe chete.
nd:
I-Skills Passport yakho isilungile.

Inombolo ye-passport: *{code}*
Isigaba: Starter
Ikhasi lakho: {link}

Okulandelayo: bhala umsebenzi wakho wokuqala. Ngemva komsebenzi ngamunye, thumela imifanekiso le-voice note emfitshane, umthengi wakho aqinisekise ngokucindezela kanye.

en: You already have a Skills Passport ({code}).
Hi {name}. What would you like to do?
Questions, field agent, report a client
What kind of job was it?
Send 1 to {max} photos from *before* you started.
nd: Thumela imifanekiso e-1 kusiya ku-{max} *ungakaqali* umsebenzi.

en: Optional: send up to {max} photos from *before* you started, or tap Skip.
sn: Hazvimanikidzwi: tumira mifananidzo inosvika {max} *usati* watanga, kana dzvanya Darika.
nd: Akusibopho: thumela imifanekiso efika ku-{max} *ungakaqali*, kumbe ucindezele Yeqa.

en: Now send 1 to {max} photos of the *finished* work. You can also send one video of up to 60 seconds.
sn: Zvino tumira mifananidzo 1 kusvika {max} yebasa *rapera*. Unogonawo kutumira vhidhiyo imwe isingapfuuri 60 seconds.
nd: Khathesi thumela imifanekiso e-1 kusiya ku-{max} yomsebenzi *oseqediwe*. Ungathumela levidiyo eyodwa engedluli imizuzwana engu-60.

en: Got it ({count}). Send more, or tap Done.
sn: Zvagamuchirwa ({count}). Tumira zvimwe, kana dzvanya Zvapera.
nd: Kwamukelwe ({count}). Thumela okunye, kumbe ucindezele Sengiqedile.

en: Please send at least one photo first.
That's the maximum for this step. Tap Done to continue.
sn: Ndizvo zvakawanda zvinobvumirwa. Dzvanya Zvapera kuti uenderere.
nd: Lokho yikho okunengi okuvunyelweyo. Cindezela Sengiqedile ukuze uqhubeke.

en: That video is longer than {max} seconds. Please send a shorter one.
sn: Vhidhiyo iyi yakareba kupfuura {max} seconds. Tumira ipfupi.
nd: Ividiyo le yinde kulemizuzwana engu-{max}. Thumela emfitshane.

en:
Send a voice note (up to 2 minutes): what you did, the materials you used and any problem you solved.

Prefer questions? Tap *Answer 3 questions*.
sn:
Tumira voice note (isingapfuuri maminitsi 2): zvawaita, zvinhu zvawashandisa nedambudziko rawagadzirisa.

Unoda mibvunzo here? Dzvanya *Pindura mibvunzo 3*.
nd:
Thumela i-voice note (engedluli imizuzu emi-2): okwenzileyo, izinto osebenzise zona lenkinga oyixazululileyo.

Uthanda imibuzo? Cindezela *Phendula imibuzo emi-3*.

en: 1 of 3: What did you do on this job? Send a voice note or text.
sn: 1 pa3: Wakaitei pabasa iri? Tumira voice note kana meseji.
nd: 1 kwemi-3: Wenzeni kulumsebenzi? Thumela i-voice note kumbe umbhalo.

en: 2 of 3: What materials did you use?
3 of 3: Was there a problem you had to solve? How did you solve it?
sn: 3 pa3: Pane dambudziko rawakasangana naro here? Wakarigadzirisa sei?
nd: 3 kwemi-3: Ikhona inkinga ohlangabezane layo yini? Uyixazulule njani?

en: That voice note is longer than 2 minutes. Please send a shorter one.
sn: Voice note iyi yakareba kupfuura maminitsi 2. Tumira ipfupi.
nd: I-voice note le yinde kulemizuzu emi-2. Thumela emfitshane.

en: Please send a voice note, or tap *Answer 3 questions*.
sn: Tumira voice note, kana dzvanya *Pindura mibvunzo 3*.
nd: Thumela i-voice note, kumbe ucindezele *Phendula imibuzo emi-3*.

en: What is the client's phone number? You can also share their WhatsApp contact.
sn: Nhamba yefoni yemutengi ndeipi? Unogonawo kugovera contact yake yeWhatsApp.
nd: Inombolo yefoni yomthengi ngubani? Ungabelana lathi nge-contact yakhe ye-WhatsApp.

en: That doesn't look like a valid mobile number. Try 077 123 4567 or +263 77 123 4567.
sn: Iyi haiite senhamba chaiyo. Edza 077 123 4567 kana +263 77 123 4567.
nd: Lokhu akubukeki njengenombolo eqondileyo. Zama 077 123 4567 kumbe +263 77 123 4567.

en: You can't confirm your own job. Please send your client's number.
sn: Haugoni kusimbisa basa rako pachako. Tumira nhamba yemutengi.
nd: Ngeke uqinisekise umsebenzi wakho ngokwakho. Thumela inombolo yomthengi.

en: That number belongs to a registered artisan or verifier. Please send your client's own number.
sn: Nhamba iyi ndeyemhizha kana muongorori akanyoreswa. Tumira nhamba yemutengi chaiyo.
nd: Inombolo le ngeyengcitshi kumbe umhloli obhalisiweyo. Thumela inombolo yomthengi uqobo.

en: That client can't confirm jobs on Skills Passport. Please choose a different client.
sn: Mutengi uyu haagoni kusimbisa mabasa paSkills Passport. Sarudza mumwe mutengi.
nd: Umthengi lo angeke aqinisekise imisebenzi ku-Skills Passport. Khetha omunye umthengi.

en: When did you do this job?
Send the date as day/month, for example 12/11.
Please send a date within the last 90 days as day/month, for example 12/11.
sn: Tumira zuva riri mukati memazuva 90 apfuura sezuva/mwedzi, semuenzaniso 12/11.
nd: Thumela usuku olungaphakathi kwensuku ezingu-90 ezedlulileyo, isibonelo 12/11.

en: Optional: share the job location. It adds trust and is never shown publicly. Tap the attach button, then Location — or tap Skip.
sn: Hazvimanikidzwi: govera nzvimbo yebasa. Zvinowedzera kuvimbika uye hazviratidzwe pachena. Dzvanya bhatani rekubatanidza, wozoti Location — kana dzvanya Darika.
nd: Akusibopho: yabelana ngendawo yomsebenzi. Kwengeza ukuthenjwa futhi kakukhonjiswa obala. Cindezela inkinobho yokunamathisela, ubusukhetha Location — kumbe ucindezele Yeqa.

en: Optional: how much did you charge, in US dollars? This stays private. Send a number like 45, or tap Skip.
sn: Hazvimanikidzwi: wakabhadharisa marii, muUS dollars? Izvi zvinoramba zvakavanzika. Tumira nhamba yakaita se45, kana dzvanya Darika.
nd: Akusibopho: ubhadalise malini, nge-US dollar? Lokhu kuhlala kuyimfihlo. Thumela inombolo efana lo-45, kumbe ucindezele Yeqa.

en: Please send a number like 45 or 45.50, or tap Skip.
sn: Tumira nhamba yakaita se45 kana 45.50, kana dzvanya Darika.
nd: Thumela inombolo efana lo-45 kumbe 45.50, kumbe ucindezele Yeqa.

en:
Job *{ref}* submitted.

We are sending {client} a WhatsApp message to confirm it. We will tell you when they reply.
sn:
Basa *{ref}* ratumirwa.

Tiri kutumira {client} meseji yeWhatsApp kuti asimbise. Tichakuudza kana vapindura.
nd:
Umsebenzi *{ref}* uthunyelwe.

Sithumela u-{client} umlayezo we-WhatsApp ukuthi aqinisekise. Sizakwazisa nxa ephendula.

en: Photo {n} looks too {problem}. Please take it again in good light, holding the phone steady.
sn: Mufananidzo {n} wakanyanya ku{problem}. Tora zvakare pachiedza chakanaka, wakabata foni zvakasimba.
nd: Umfanekiso {n} ubukeka u{problem} kakhulu. Wuthathe futhi ekukhanyeni okuhle, ubambe ifoni iqine.

en: You were logging a job ({jobType}). Continue where you left off?
sn: Wanga uchinyora basa ({jobType}). Enderera pawasiya here?
nd: Ububhala umsebenzi ({jobType}). Uqhubeke lapho omise khona yini?

en: There are no job types set up for your trade yet. A field agent will help you.
sn: Hapana mhando dzemabasa dzakagadzirirwa basa renyu parizvino. Mumiriri achakubatsira.
nd: Azikho izinhlobo zemisebenzi ezilungiselelwe umsebenzi wakho okwamanje. Umsebenzi wasendaweni uzakunceda.

en: Send the correct description as a text or voice note.
sn: Tumira tsananguro chaiyo semeseji kana voice note.
nd: Thumela incazelo eqondileyo ngombhalo kumbe nge-voice note.

en: Thanks. We updated the description for {ref}.
Thank you. The job is confirmed. You can rate the work here: {link}
sn: Tatenda. Basa rasimbiswa. Munogona kupa mamaki pano: {link}
nd: Siyabonga. Umsebenzi uqinisekisiwe. Unganika amamaki lapha: {link}

en: Thank you for telling us. We will look into this job.
Done. You will not receive more messages from Skills Passport.
sn: Zvaitwa. Hamuchazowani mamwe mameseji kubva kuSkills Passport.
nd: Kwenziwe. Kawusayikuthola eminye imilayezo evela ku-Skills Passport.

en: This job has already been answered. Thank you.
Skills Passport turns artisans’ real work into a verified record. Send *hi* to create your own passport.
sn: Skills Passport inoshandura basa chairo remhizha kuita rekodhi yakasimbiswa. Tumira *hi* kuti uvhure passport yako.
nd: I-Skills Passport iguqula umsebenzi weqiniso wengcitshi ube yirekhodi eqinisekisiweyo. Thumela *hi* ukuze uvule eyakho.
U-{client} unike umsebenzi *{ref}* amamaki angu-{rating} kwangu-5.

en: {client} said job *{ref}* was not done. A verifier will look at it. If this is a mistake, send *help*.
sn: {client} vati basa *{ref}* harina kuitwa. Muongorori acharitarisa. Kana kuri kukanganisa, tumira *help*.
nd: U-{client} uthe umsebenzi *{ref}* kawenziwanga. Umhloli uzawuhlola. Nxa kuyiphutha, thumela *help*.

en: {client} didn't answer about job *{ref}* within 7 days. A field agent may call them.
sn: {client} havana kupindura nezvebasa *{ref}* mukati memazuva 7. Mumiriri angavafonera.
nd: U-{client} kaphendulanga ngomsebenzi *{ref}* phakathi kwensuku ezi-7. Umsebenzi wasendaweni angamfonela.

en: We couldn't reach {client} on WhatsApp for job *{ref}*. A field agent will try to call them.
sn: Hatina kukwanisa kusvika ku{client} paWhatsApp nezvebasa *{ref}*. Mumiriri achaedza kuvafonera.
nd: Asikwazanga ukufinyelela u-{client} ku-WhatsApp ngomsebenzi *{ref}*. Umsebenzi wasendaweni uzazama ukumfonela.

en: {client} has stopped messages from Skills Passport, so we can't ask them about job *{ref}*. A field agent will follow up.
sn: {client} vakamisa mameseji eSkills Passport, saka hatigoni kuvabvunza nezvebasa *{ref}*. Mumiriri achatevera.
nd: U-{client} uvimbele imilayezo ye-Skills Passport, ngakho kasingeke simbuze ngomsebenzi *{ref}*. Umsebenzi wasendaweni uzalandela.
Isigaba sakho siguquke saba yi-*{level}*. Isizatho: {reason}

en: some jobs or endorsements no longer count.
A master artisan reviewed job *{ref}*: meets the standard.
sn: Mhizha huru yaongorora basa *{ref}*: rakasvika pamwero.
nd: Ingcitshi enkulu ihlole umsebenzi *{ref}*: ufinyelela izinga.

en: A master artisan reviewed job *{ref}*: needs improvement.
sn: Mhizha huru yaongorora basa *{ref}*: rinoda kuvandudzwa.
nd: Ingcitshi enkulu ihlole umsebenzi *{ref}*: udinga ukuthuthukiswa.

en: A master artisan reviewed job *{ref}*: not accepted.
sn: Mhizha huru yaongorora basa *{ref}*: harina kugamuchirwa.

en: {verifier} has endorsed you as a {trade} artisan. This is shown on your passport.
sn: {verifier} vakutsigira semhizha ye{trade}. Izvi zvinoratidzwa papassport yenyu.
nd: U-{verifier} ukusekele njengengcitshi ye-{trade}. Lokhu kukhonjiswa ku-passport yakho.

en: An endorsement on your passport was withdrawn.
A master artisan would like to see a practical demonstration for job *{ref}*. A field agent will contact you to arrange it.
sn: Mhizha huru inoda kuona muenzaniso webasa *{ref}*. Mumiriri achakuonai kuti murongerane.
nd: Ingcitshi enkulu ifuna ukubona umboniso womsebenzi *{ref}*. Umsebenzi wasendaweni uzakuthinta ukuze lihlele.

en: Your level is on hold while our team checks some recent jobs. A field agent may contact you.
sn: Chikamu chenyu chamiswa apo timu yedu ichiongorora mamwe mabasa. Mumiriri angakuonai.
nd: Isigaba sakho simisiwe ngesikhathi iqembu lethu lihlola eminye imisebenzi. Umsebenzi wasendaweni angakuthinta.

sn: Mamwe mabasa {n} akasimbiswa kuti usvike pa{level}.
nd: Eminye imisebenzi engu-{n} eqinisekisiweyo ukuze ufike ku-{level}.

sn: Rimwe basa 1 rakasimbiswa kuti usvike pa{level}.
nd: Omunye umsebenzi o-1 oqinisekisiweyo ukuze ufike ku-{level}.

en: {n} more jobs from new clients to reach {level}.
sn: Mamwe mabasa {n} kubva kuvatengi vatsva kuti usvike pa{level}.
nd: Eminye imisebenzi engu-{n} evela kubathengi abatsha ukuze ufike ku-{level}.

en: 1 more job from a new client to reach {level}.
sn: Rimwe basa 1 kubva kumutengi mutsva kuti usvike pa{level}.
nd: Omunye umsebenzi o-1 ovela kumthengi omutsha ukuze ufike ku-{level}.

en: Next level: {level}. Send *menu* and choose My passport to see what is left.
sn: Chikamu chinotevera: {level}. Tumira *menu* usarudze Passport yangu kuti uone zvasara.
nd: Isigaba esilandelayo: {level}. Thumela *menu* ukhethe I-passport yami ukuze ubone okusele.

en: You are at Gold, the highest level. Keep logging jobs to keep your passport current.
sn: Muri paGold, chikamu chepamusoro. Rambai muchinyora mabasa kuti passport irambe ichiratidza zvazvino.
nd: Useku-Gold, isigaba esiphezulu. Qhubeka ubhala imisebenzi ukuze i-passport ihlale imutsha.

en: Your level is on hold while our team checks recent jobs.
sn: Chikamu chenyu chakamiswa apo timu ichiongorora mabasa.
nd: Isigaba sakho simisiwe ngesikhathi iqembu lihlola imisebenzi.

en: Endorsements from different master artisans: {have} of {need}
Jobs reviewed as meeting the standard: {have} of {need}
No jobs are waiting for clients right now.
We have already sent the most reminders allowed for this job.
sn: Tatotumira zviyeuchidzo zvese zvinobvumirwa pabasa iri.

en: Send the client's correct phone number.
Updated. We sent the confirmation request to the new number.
Forward the next message to clients, or post the card on your WhatsApp Status.
sn: Endesa meseji inotevera kuvatengi, kana isa kadhi paWhatsApp Status yako.
nd: Dlulisela umlayezo olandelayo kubathengi, kumbe ufake ikhadi ku-WhatsApp Status yakho.

en: My Skills Passport: {name}, {trade}, level {level}. Confirmed by real clients: {link}
sn: Skills Passport yangu: {name}, {trade}, chikamu {level}. Yakasimbiswa nevatengi chaivo: {link}
nd: I-Skills Passport yami: {name}, {trade}, isigaba {level}. Iqinisekiswe ngabathengi beqiniso: {link}

en: QR code for {code}. Print it or show it to clients.
sn: QR code ye{code}. Iprinte kana uiratidze vatengi.
nd: I-QR code ka-{code}. Yiphrinte kumbe uyitshengise abathengi.

en: Post this on your WhatsApp Status.
You have no open work requests.
You accepted. Contact {contact} at {phone}. They now have your number too.
sn: Mabvuma. Bata {contact} pa{phone}. Vava nenhamba yenyu futi.
nd: Wamukele. Thinta u-{contact} ku-{phone}. Labo sebelayo inombolo yakho.

en: This request is no longer open.
Great. Log it as a confirmed job with {buyer} as the client?
sn: Zvakanaka. Rinyore sebasa rakasimbiswa, {buyer} ari mutengi here?
nd: Kuhle. Uwubhale njengomsebenzi oqinisekisiweyo, u-{buyer} engumthengi yini?

en:
*How Skills Passport works*
1. After a job, log it here with photos and a voice note.
2. Your client confirms with one tap.
3. A master artisan checks some of your jobs.
4. Your level rises as confirmed jobs, clients and endorsements grow.

Your passport is a record of real work. It is not an official trade-test certificate.
sn:
*Kushanda kweSkills Passport*
1. Mushure mebasa, rinyore pano nemifananidzo nevoice note.
2. Mutengi anosimbisa nekudzvanya kamwe.
3. Mhizha huru inoongorora mamwe mabasa.
4. Chikamu chenyu chinokwira mabasa, vatengi nekutsigirwa zvichiwedzera.

Passport yenyu irekodhi yebasa chairo. Haisi setifiketi yepamutemo ye trade test.
nd:
*Indlela i-Skills Passport esebenza ngayo*
1. Ngemva komsebenzi, wubhale lapha ngemifanekiso le-voice note.
2. Umthengi wakho uqinisekisa ngokucindezela kanye.
3. Ingcitshi enkulu ihlola eminye imisebenzi.
4. Isigaba sakho siyakhuphuka njengoba imisebenzi, abathengi lokusekelwa kukhula.

I-passport yakho yirekhodi yomsebenzi weqiniso. Kayisiso isitifiketi esisemthethweni se-trade test.

en: A field agent will contact you within 2 working days.
nd: Umsebenzi wasendaweni uzakuthinta phakathi kwensuku ezi-2 zokusebenza.

en: Which client do you want to report?
You have no clients to report.
Why are you reporting this client?
Thank you. Your report is recorded and this client can no longer send you work through Skills Passport. If you are in danger, call the police on 995.
sn: Tatenda. Kumhan’ara kwenyu kwanyorwa uye mutengi uyu haachakwanisi kukutumira basa kuburikidza neSkills Passport. Kana muri munjodzi, fonai mapurisa pa995.

nd: Akukabi lokusekelwa. Izingcitshi ezinkulu zisekela ngemva kokuhlola imisebenzi eminengi.

en: Every job here was confirmed by the client who paid for it. Master artisans in the same trade review a share of jobs and endorse artisans whose work meets the standard. Photos are checked for duplicates. This passport is a record of real work, not an official trade-test certificate.
sn: Basa rega rega pano rakasimbiswa nemutengi akaribhadhara. Mhizha huru dzebasa rimwe chete dzinoongorora mamwe mabasa uye dzinotsigira mhizha dzine basa rakasvika pamwero. Mifananidzo inoongororwa kuti hapana yakadzokororwa. Passport iyi irekodhi yebasa chairo, kwete setifiketi yepamutemo ye trade test.
nd: Umsebenzi ngamunye lapha uqinisekiswe ngumthengi owubhadeleyo. Izingcitshi ezinkulu zomsebenzi ofananayo zihlola eminye imisebenzi njalo zisekela izingcitshi ezilomsebenzi ofinyelela izinga. Imifanekiso iyahlolwa ukuthi ayiphindwanga. Le passport yirekhodi yomsebenzi weqiniso, kayisiso isitifiketi esisemthethweni se-trade test.

nd: Abathengi bangathumela isicelo somsebenzi. Imininingwane yokuxhumana yabelwana kuphela nxa ingcitshi ivuma.
